_comment: Which third-party mods each *WithMods run folder carries, and where to get them.
This is the machine-readable twin of AGENTS.md, 'Testing against the real mods' - keep the
two in step. fetch-mod-jars.ps1 reads this; nothing else does.
'slug' is the Modrinth project slug. 'loaders' is what that project publishes that we use -
Repurposed Structures ships its NeoForge build under the '-forge' slug, which is why the two
entries below point at different projects.
The set changes across Minecraft versions: Shogi only became a Waystones dependency on 26.x,
and Forge lost both Waystones and Repurposed Structures. When a version upgrade changes the
set, edit this file - do not special-case it in the script.
As of 26.2 Balm has no Forge build either, so both forge folders install nothing and the
script reports 'NOT PUBLISHED'. The entries are kept deliberately: they cost nothing while
the build is missing and pick it up automatically the moment Balm ships for 26.2.
